source_published_anchor.reported_context: petal length was on average smaller in island than continental populations, especially in Galapagos

expected_source_components: island versus continental habitat or locality identity
claim_boundary: This widespread-species dataset may support island-versus-continent petal-length divergence and environmental moderation within Tribulus cistoides. It is one lineage, not an independent sister-taxon meta-analysis. Flower size is not effective pollinator dependency, and habitat contrasts do not identify pollinator or geological-origin causation.
